# Travels

- [Travels Documentation](/docs): Learn, integrate, and operate patch-based undo/redo with Travels 3.
- Getting Started
  - [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation): Install Travels 3 and Mutative 2 in a TypeScript or JavaScript application.
  - [Quick Start](/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Create a timeline, record edits, navigate history, and restore a snapshot.
  - [Choosing Travels](/docs/getting-started/choosing-travels): Understand when patch-based history is a better fit than snapshots, CRDTs, or a simpler undo stack.
- Core Concepts
  - [How Travels Works](/docs/concepts/how-it-works): Follow state, forward patches, inverse patches, positions, and branches through one timeline.
  - [State Requirements](/docs/concepts/state-requirements): Use state, patch values, paths, and metadata that remain correct through replay and JSON persistence.
  - [History Lifecycle](/docs/concepts/history-lifecycle): Manage retained windows, baselines, reset, rebase, trimming, and branch replacement.
- Guides
  - [History Guides](/docs/guides): Practical guidance for updates, navigation, grouping, observers, ownership, and failures.
  - [Updating State](/docs/guides/updating-state): Use draft mutations, replacement values, metadata, and synchronous updates correctly.
  - [Navigation and Controls](/docs/guides/navigation-and-controls): Move through history and expose the right read-only capabilities to UI components.
  - [Archive Mode](/docs/guides/archive-mode): Choose automatic entries or explicitly group pending updates with manual archives.
  - [Transactions](/docs/guides/transactions): Group synchronous updates into one atomic history entry and one settled observer event.
  - [Tracking and Replacement](/docs/guides/tracking-and-replacement): Apply untracked updates, replace authoritative state, and deliberately reset the history baseline.
  - [Mutable Mode](/docs/guides/mutable-mode): Preserve reactive object identity while recording reversible patches.
  - [Controlled Journal](/docs/guides/controlled-journal): Connect Travels history to a runtime that already owns state and commits.
  - [Observers and Events](/docs/guides/observers-and-events): Subscribe to committed transitions and consume shared read-only event data safely.
  - [Error Handling](/docs/guides/error-handling): Handle typed operation errors, persistence failures, warnings, and observer errors without corrupting history.
  - [Advanced Patterns](/docs/guides/advanced-patterns): Extend Travels with validation, permissions, metadata, logging, and composable wrappers.
- Integrations
  - [Framework Integrations](/docs/integrations): Choose immutable, mutable, official-binding, or externally owned history for your state architecture.
  - [React Integration](/docs/integrations/react): Bind a Travels timeline to React with useSyncExternalStore and revision-based invalidation.
  - [Vue Integration](/docs/integrations/vue): Use immutable refs or preserve a reactive store reference with mutable mode.
  - [Zustand Integration](/docs/integrations/zustand): Use zustand-travel v3 or synchronize a core immutable timeline with a Zustand store.
  - [MobX and Pinia](/docs/integrations/mobx-pinia): Preserve observable store identity with mutable timelines and explicit undoable writes.
  - [Forms and External Stores](/docs/integrations/external-stores): Keep a form manager or state runtime authoritative while adding reliable undo/redo history.
- Persistence
  - [Persistence](/docs/persistence): Serialize, validate, store, restore, and migrate complete Travels timelines.
  - [Storage Adapters](/docs/persistence/storage-adapters): Production-oriented persistence adapters for Dexie, idb, localForage, and localspace.
  - [Migration and Recovery](/docs/persistence/migration-and-recovery): Migrate older snapshots, select validation depth, and recover intentionally from invalid history.
  - [Security and Integrity](/docs/persistence/security-and-integrity): Understand what semantic validation proves and where authentication, revisions, and conflict handling belong.
- Migration
  - [Migration Guide](/docs/migration): Upgrade to Travels 3 or migrate from snapshot-based history libraries.
- Reference
  - [Configuration Options](/docs/reference/options): Reference for timeline creation, restore, persistence, patches, hooks, and Mutative options.
  - [Instance Methods](/docs/reference/instance-methods): A task-oriented index of timeline, journal, navigation, history, and persistence methods.
  - [TypeScript Guide](/docs/reference/typescript): Infer timeline types, enforce durable state, and use read-only views and open event types safely.
  - [Compatibility Policy](/docs/reference/compatibility): Supported runtimes, browsers, state shapes, official bindings, and versioning.
- Resources
  - [Examples](/docs/resources/examples): Runnable and copyable Travels examples for core history, frameworks, persistence, and editing applications.
  - [Troubleshooting](/docs/resources/troubleshooting): Diagnose common update, navigation, persistence, mutable-mode, and integration problems.
  - [Testing Strategy](/docs/resources/testing): Correctness, property-based, browser, mutation, and hot-path performance testing.
  - [Contributing](/docs/resources/contributing): Set up the repository, make focused changes, and validate a contribution.
  - [Security Policy](/docs/resources/security): Supported versions and the responsible vulnerability reporting process.
  - [Release Checklist](/docs/resources/release-checklist): The project checklist for validating and publishing a Travels release.
- API Reference
  - [API Reference](/docs/api-reference): Complete source-generated reference for every public Travels 3 export.
  - Functions
    - [assertTravelHistoryEntryRecordable()](/docs/api-reference/functions/assertTravelHistoryEntryRecordable): Preflight a controlled patch pair before an external commit.
    - [createPatchableTravels()](/docs/api-reference/functions/createPatchableTravels): Create a timeline constrained to the durable JSON-shaped state contract.
    - [createTravelJournal()](/docs/api-reference/functions/createTravelJournal): Record history for a runtime that already owns state and patches.
    - [createTravels()](/docs/api-reference/functions/createTravels): Create a state-owning timeline with automatic or manual archiving.
    - [findStateCompatibilityIssues()](/docs/api-reference/functions/findStateCompatibilityIssues): Inspect state, patches, and metadata for persistence hazards.
    - [isTravels()](/docs/api-reference/functions/isTravels): Detect a state-owning timeline created by this copy of Travels.
    - [restoreTravelJournal()](/docs/api-reference/functions/restoreTravelJournal): Restore a controlled journal from a complete history snapshot.
    - [restoreTravels()](/docs/api-reference/functions/restoreTravels): Restore a complete validated Travels history snapshot.
    - [validateTravelHistoryEntry()](/docs/api-reference/functions/validateTravelHistoryEntry): Validate a forward and inverse history entry.
    - [validateTravelPatches()](/docs/api-reference/functions/validateTravelPatches): Validate JSON Patch structure and retained patch values.
